convert.auth: none (code is the credential; single-use, short-lived)

create.session: authenticated account session (web) — the ONLY web-bound creation step; no REST create endpoint exists

install.note: each installation is a separate principal with its own rate-limit bucket
install.session: web consent of the installing account admin — no REST install endpoint exists

installation_token.buckets: per-installation, independent of the user PAT bucket (5000/h) and of the Actions GITHUB_TOKEN bucket (1000/h/repo)
use_routes: all repo-scoped REST routes within granted permissions

key_lifecycle.bootstrap_key: delivered once by the conversions response (pem)
key_lifecycle.rotation: web UI only (app settings -> Private keys) — names/last-used recorded, values never in chat
key_lifecycle.storage: 0600 local file or vault entry; referenced by path/env name only
